where: Every inn and rest point — the Vesper Crossroads Inn, the Pearlmoor Quayside Inn, the Lowleaf Guest-bower, Galehigh's Steady Gust, the Pale Vault's Held Flame and Nightreach's Long Watch
mood: Rest a while — a fire's glow, a full kettle and a warm bed; the hometown tune settled into a contented waltz.
_note: Matches the classic: 90 BPM, 3/4, F major, AABA; the Vesper lift-and-settle on a low flute. Motif medium shares the hometown tune's DNA (and its ~90 BPM grid). Contrast tinderwick-b (6/8 A-minor homesick lullaby): this is major, settled, contented. Small room: harp, low strings, flute, music box.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
soft low flute singing a warm contented melody
a sleepy music-box glint at the phrase ends
soft round bass on the downbeats
cosy inn by the fire at night, safe and welcome, sleep sound, close and intimate with a short warm room reverb

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {coming in from the road: a soft harp arpeggio rolls warmly, a music-box glint, and the low flute's first lifting notes settle straight into the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the contented waltz on low flute in F major: a hopeful lift that rises a step past home, then settles gently back; harp and strings glowing underneath}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same melody again, the strings warmer and a soft harp counter-line weaving under the flute, like the kettle coming to the boil}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a gentle rise into B-flat major, the flute higher and kinder, a moment of warm reminiscence by the fire, then it eases back home}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the waltz returns in F major, calm and settled; the last bar sways straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
